title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Science - Physics - Waves and Sound
subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following increases when the amplitude of a wave increases?
questions.explain: The energy of a wave is directly proportional to the square of its amplitude ($E \propto A^2$). Therefore, when the amplitude increases, the energy transported by the wave also increases.
